paragraphs.text: When the university library at Norland reopened after renovation, visitors noticed that most of the printed books had gone from the ground floor. In their place were group study rooms, a café and rows of power sockets for laptops.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The library’s director explained that use of the printed collection had fallen by more than half in ten years, while demand for study space had doubled. The books were not thrown away but moved to a storage building, from which any volume can be delivered within a day.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Not all students welcomed the change. Some said that browsing the shelves had often led them to useful books they would never have found through a search engine, and a petition asked for part of the collection to be returned.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Research on browsing supports their concern to some extent. A study at another university found that students who borrowed books from open shelves frequently took out a second book from the same shelf, something that rarely happened when books had to be requested.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: In response, the library created a browsing room on the second floor with a changing selection of 5,000 titles chosen by subject librarians. The selection is replaced every term.
paragraphs.label: E

paragraphs.text: The director believes that the library’s purpose has not changed, only its form. A library, she argues, has always been a place for study and discovery, whether that happens with a book, a screen or a conversation.
paragraphs.label: F

items.quote: In response, the library created a browsing room on the second floor
items.prompt: a compromise made after students complained

explanation.en: “In response” to the complaints and petition in C, the library “created a browsing room” → E. The complaints are in C, but the compromise is in E.
explanation.kk: «In response» — шағым мен петицияға (C абзацы) жауап ретінде кітапхана «created a browsing room» → E. Шағымның өзі C-да, ал ымыра E-де.
explanation.ru: «In response» — в ответ на жалобы и петицию (абзац C) библиотека «created a browsing room» → E. Сами жалобы — в C, но компромисс — в E.

items.quote: use of the printed collection had fallen by more than half in ten years, while demand for study space had doubled
items.prompt: figures showing a change in how the library was used

explanation.en: The figures: use of books fell “by more than half” and demand for study space “had doubled” → B. The 5,000 in E is a number of titles, not a change in use.
explanation.kk: Сандар: кітаптарды пайдалану «more than half» азайған, оқу орнына сұраныс «had doubled» → B. E-дегі 5,000 — пайдаланудың өзгерісі емес, кітап саны.
explanation.ru: Цифры: книгами стали пользоваться «more than half» меньше, спрос на места для учёбы «had doubled» → B. 5,000 в E — число книг, а не изменение использования.

items.quote: the library’s purpose has not changed, only its form
items.prompt: a view that the role of libraries has stayed the same

explanation.en: The director thinks only the form has changed: “the library’s purpose has not changed, only its form”. “Role” paraphrases “purpose” → F.
explanation.kk: Директор кітапхананың тек түрі өзгерді деп санайды: «the library’s purpose has not changed, only its form». «Role» — «purpose» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы → F.
explanation.ru: Директор считает, что изменилась только форма библиотеки: «the library’s purpose has not changed, only its form». «Role» пересказывает «purpose» → F.

items.quote: students who borrowed books from open shelves frequently took out a second book from the same shelf
items.prompt: a study of how borrowers behave

explanation.en: A study at another university looked at borrowers’ behaviour: those using open shelves “frequently took out a second book from the same shelf” → D.
explanation.kk: Басқа университеттегі зерттеу оқырмандардың әрекетін қарастырған: ашық сөреден кітап алғандар «frequently took out a second book from the same shelf» → D.
explanation.ru: Исследование в другом университете изучало поведение читателей: те, кто брал книги с открытых полок, «frequently took out a second book from the same shelf» → D.

items.quote: moved to a storage building, from which any volume can be delivered within a day
items.prompt: the way students can still get books that were moved

explanation.en: Books went to storage, “from which any volume can be delivered within a day” → B. B repeats, which the NB allows. The room in E holds only a selection, not any book.
explanation.kk: Кітаптар қоймаға көшірілген, «from which any volume can be delivered within a day» → B. B әрпі қайталанады — нұсқаулықтағы NB рұқсат береді. E-дегі бөлмеде кез келген кітап емес, бір бөлігі ғана бар.
explanation.ru: Книги перевезли на склад, «from which any volume can be delivered within a day» → B. Буква B повторяется — это разрешено NB в инструкции. Комната в E даёт лишь часть книг, а не любые.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has six paragraphs, A–F. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–F. NB You may use any letter more than once.
